"Shot 69 on a 6,900 yard golf course"

Send this to the guy in your foursome who thinks he can beat the course without a 9 iron.
Bryson DeChambeau talks through his aggressive shot, which ends up going in and helping him shoot a 69 on a notoriously tough course.
